purpose: Curated portable audit/report handoff for a Mac clone; paths are repository-relative and intended for explicit force-add, never a recursive add of the artifacts directory.

summary.note: Sizes are a preparation snapshot; root may regenerate delivery-state reports before committing. The manifest itself is excluded from the byte total to avoid self-reference.

inspection.contentReview: Retained material consists of audit prose, code/diagnostics, synthetic test outcomes and aggregate benchmark/coverage evidence. No real manuscript payload or actual credential was identified in the reviewed retained files. This is a bounded content review, not a comprehensive secret-scanner certification. Some historical source/test diagnostics retain repository paths, machine metadata and synthetic fixture names.
inspection.publicationMetadataReview: Five verified dev commit records and counts of preserved local files. Unrelated legacy filenames and local working-directory paths are omitted; the full local preservation record is not committed. Legacy metadata-only scope and the unpublished Qwen 0.4 loader fixture are stated explicitly.
inspection.logNormalization: Trailing whitespace in the retained mobile build log is normalized; diagnostic text and exit-result evidence are unchanged.

excluded: Cached Windows/Linux SDKs, Electron, node_modules, NuGet/npm caches and extracted Debian libraries/packages
All binaries, archives, copied source/build output, synthetic profiles/projects and fixture directories
Screenshots and UI PNG captures; the HTML reports embed their styling and scripts and do not depend on them
Large raw Chromium trace files and full P01 per-process sampling JSON; summary.json preserves every reported metric value and selected trace events
Large full-suite TRX and coverage XML/report directories; workstream ledgers retain result/coverage summaries
speech-runtime-prerequisites.json (optional hardware check containing local personal profile/cache paths)
referencesNotCarried: p01-desktop/summary.json names measured.json, trace.json and runs/* raw evidence; those large local-only records and built variant outputs are omitted. Benchmark scripts are retained as method documentation; their outputs must be generated anew to rerun analysis.

linux-validation/summary.json names build/setup logs, cached runtimes and WSL scripts not carried. Compact results, source hashes and Node22 logs are retained; the Mac does not need the Linux runtime fixture.

speech-acceptance-evidence.json references optional speech-runtime-prerequisites.json, omitted for local-path privacy. No GPU/model inference was performed; the original portable Speech acceptance is recorded independently.
Workstream ledgers reference full coverage/test archives and historical copied host fixtures not carried; summaries and current production test sources remain available.
Cross-repository source links require sibling clones of the corresponding repositories. Historical legacy repository source links remain informational; no legacy binaries/host snapshots are included.
rebuildNotes: Rebuild implementation.html with build-implementation-report.py using retained ledgers/CSS/native fragment and p01-desktop/summary.json.
Preserve audit.html and findings.json as the original pre-fix baseline. build-report.py is retained for provenance; running it at a different source revision would rewrite baseline evidence URLs.
The generated progress-root.json is recreated by root_progress() in build-implementation-report.py; edit that source or appropriate source workstream ledgers for lasting updates.
Ten native findings remain pending: M01-M06, R13-R15, P01. Curated evidence does not imply native runtime validation.
No hashes of mutable generated reports are stored in this manifest. Refresh the preparation-size snapshot after regenerating reports if desired; the paths list is the staging contract.
